Correctly expands ^0.1.2-alpha.1 and shows it selects published 0.1.2-alpha.2 without install failure, identifying the silent declaration-vs-baseline mismatch and citing R-11 type-surface drift as the compatibility uncertainty.

Multiple complete feasible plans with tradeoffs: re-baseline to the published alpha.2 with honest README and one-time typecheck, or the Path 3 lane obtaining the alpha.1 source ref, building and pinning file: tarballs via overrides (tag existence honestly marked unconfirmed).

Lockfile committed with CI frozen install, proposed typecheck against installed declarations with baseline-exemption attribution, explicit exit paths to remove overrides/tarball store once a verified equivalent is available, and an unconfirmed list; managers not required to be mixed.
